summary.text: A system description of Aurora DSQL, a serverless, multi-region active-active SQL database. Compute, storage and transaction coordination are separated into independently scalable services, with PostgreSQL-compatible query processors running statelessly in Firecracker MicroVMs. It uses multiversion concurrency control with precision timestamps for coordination-free reads and optimistic concurrency control for writes, deferring coordination to commit time so that cross-region latency is paid only on commit.
summary.relationship_to_sqlancer: A database system paper rather than a testing paper. It cites SQLancer among the work on database correctness; the abstract does not describe using it.
supporting_excerpts: Aurora DSQL is a serverless SQL database designed for cloud-scale transaction processing with multi-region active-active capabilities.

The system uses multiversion concurrency control with precision timestamps for coordination-free reads and optimistic concurrency control for writes, deferring coordination to commit time through distributed adjudicators and the Journal replication system.

sources.excerpt: The fuzz-testing approach, building on the approach of SQLancer [4], generates millions of example SQL statements and runs them both on DSQL and on Aurora PostgreSQL.
